name: Morten
abilityNote: Standard array (15 INT, 14 DEX, 13 CON, 12 WIS, 10 CHA, 8 STR) + Sage (+2 INT, +1 CON).

attacks.name: Oil flask (thrown)
attacks.damage: covered: +5 fire if hit by fire within 1 min

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.line: Spell attack, 1d10 fire; ignites flammable objects.

spells.name: Ray of Frost
spells.line: Spell attack, 1d8 cold; the target's speed −3 m until your next turn.

spells.name: Shocking Grasp
spells.line: Melee spell attack, 1d8 lightning; the target can't make Opportunity Attacks until its next turn.

spells.name: Light
spells.line: An object sheds 6 m bright + 6 m dim light for 1 hour.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.line: A spectral hand for 1 minute, 4.5 kg; a Magic action to use it again.

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.line: Base AC 13 + DEX for 8 h. Once per Long Rest with no check.

spells.name: Shield
spells.line: Reaction when hit or targeted by Magic Missile: +5 AC until your next turn, the triggering attack included.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.line: 3 darts, 1d4+1 force each, never miss; +1 dart per level above 1.

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.line: 4.5 m cube from you, CON save: 2d8 thunder and a push of 3 m, half on a save; heard 90 m away.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.line: WIS save or Incapacitated, then a second save or Unconscious; 1.5 m radius; no effect on undead and constructs.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.line: Teleport 9 m to a space you can see.

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.line: 3 rays, each a spell attack, 2d6 fire.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.line: Sense magic within 9 m for 10 minutes.

spells.name: Feather Fall
spells.line: Reaction: up to five falling creatures fall gently for 1 minute.

spells.name: Find Familiar
spells.line: A spirit familiar (needs 10 GP of incense).

spells.name: Grease
spells.line: A 3 m square of grease: difficult terrain, DEX save or Prone.

spells.name: Shatter
spells.line: 3 m-radius sphere, CON save: 3d8 thunder, half on a save.

spells.name: Web
spells.line: A 6 m cube of webs: difficult terrain, DEX save or Restrained.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.line: Once per Long Rest, after a Short Rest: regain lost spells totalling up to 2 levels (a cantrip counts as 1).

features.name: Ritual Adept
features.line: Cast Ritual spells from the spellbook unprepared, +10 minutes, no casting check.

features.name: Evocation Savant
features.line: Shatter and Scorching Ray copied free.

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.line: A damaging cantrip that misses (or is saved against) still deals half damage.

features.name: Alert
features.line: +2 Initiative; may swap Initiative with a willing ally.

features.name: Heroic Inspiration
features.line: Human, Resourceful: after each Long Rest, reroll any one die.

gear.name: Book (Sage)
gear.note: the trader buys it for 12 GP 5 SP

gear.name: Lamp
gear.note: 4.5 m bright + 9 m dim; 6 h per oil flask

gear.name: Oil flask
gear.note: fuel, or thrown / poured for fire

gear.name: Tinderbox
gear.note: light a torch or lamp: Bonus action

gear.name: Crowbar
gear.note: Advantage on STR checks where leverage helps

coinsNote: Starting gold: 47 GP 7 SP 5 CP. The tower's treasury (100 GP) is separate.
habits: Shield: cast as a reaction when a hit would become a miss at AC 20 and deals 4+ damage (any damage at 8 HP or less), if Shield isn't lost and the reaction is free.
Heroic Inspiration: reroll a failed cast of Shield, Misty Step, Scorching Ray, Thunderwave or Sleep.

Cheese everything: scout, rituals, Mage Hand, oil, Sleep then point-blank crits, chokepoints, Ready Shocking Grasp for the first through the door, retreat to reset, leave the purse home before a risky fight.
Rulings: monsters that flee on a morale check count as bypassed (XP given).
